knowledge_base.title: Account Lockout & Password Reset Policy
knowledge_base.description: User accounts are locked after 5 consecutive failed login attempts. Automated manual unlock tool can be executed by IT agent after employee identity verification.

knowledge_base.title: VPN Access and Credential Renewal Policy
knowledge_base.description: Full-time employees receive VPN access with auto-grant upon 90-day renewal cycle. Contractors require manager approval via access request form prior to VPN provision or renewal.

knowledge_base.title: Hardware Refresh & Laptop Replacement Policy
knowledge_base.description: Laptops are eligible for replacement if device age > 3.0 years OR if there is a verified unrepairable hardware failure. Devices under 3.0 years with minor or fixable issues must be routed to hardware repair diagnostics first.

knowledge_base.title: Software Installation & Admin Access Policy
knowledge_base.description: Non-catalog software and browser extensions require IT Security review (3-5 business days turnaround). Admin access to critical servers (e.g., finance reporting) requires explicit business justification and manager sign-off.

knowledge_base.title: Printer & Peripheral Support Policy
knowledge_base.description: For printer errors or false jams, first attempt print spooler restart remotely. If issue persists, log a ticket with the printer's Asset Tag for physical technician dispatch.

knowledge_base.title: Mailbox Quota & Expansion Policy
knowledge_base.description: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Users over quota should first archive old emails. Quota expansions above 25GB require manager approval and are strictly capped at 50GB max. Requests >50GB are unallowable per policy.

knowledge_base.title: Guest Wi-Fi Access Policy
knowledge_base.description: Guest Wi-Fi credentials (24-hour pass) are self-service via front-desk kiosks in office lobbies. No IT helpdesk ticket is required.

knowledge_base.title: Finance & Expense Tool Support Policy
knowledge_base.description: Expense software user accounts and permissions are managed directly by the Finance team. IT only assists with login issues if an account already exists in Finance. If no account exists, route to Finance immediately.

knowledge_base.title: Phishing & Security Incident Escalation
knowledge_base.description: Suspected phishing emails or security threats must be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example. Employees must NOT forward suspicious emails to colleagues.

knowledge_base.title: Work From Home (WFH) Equipment Allowance
knowledge_base.description: Employees working WFH > 3 days per week are eligible for home monitors/peripherals. Requires Manager approval sign-off and Finance budget code processing.
